# Private binary carrier calls

Untouched Java 8 compiler originals retain one private method formal across two
covariant inputs of the same unary carrier and its invariant result. Static and
instance dispatch each use source and SDK carrier declarations. Frozen callers
run before D8 and recovery, and all recovered Java, original runtime entries,
metadata and Exceptions are independently compared.

Fresh JVMs observe class initialization and sticky failures, null receivers,
null inputs, unrelated opaque element values, both original callbacks, changing
result sources, captured return identity, observer failures and later caller
casts. Seven independently wrong programs must fail the frozen observer. Native
cases additionally cover mixed input variance, copy/range forms, synthetic raw
accessors, arbitrary returned inputs and complete rejected contract boundaries.
